## Kit and version

## Manual maintainer review (required before merge)

- [ ] Identity, version increment, protocol and minimum app version verified
- [ ] Every skill, agent, rule and script reviewed (including embedded commands)
- [ ] No secrets, client data, credentials, binaries or unexpected files
- [ ] Dependencies, network access and prompt-injection risks reviewed
- [ ] Licences and redistribution permissions checked
- [ ] Guardrails, model policies and approval behavior tested in an isolated project
- [ ] No infrastructure/workflow/schema changes mixed with this submission
- [ ] Publication and release asset contents approved
